sections.text: The mountain relay crackles. Its weather warning is still unsent, and the station lights have gone dark.

consequence.text: The damaged terminals arc and burn your hand.

sections.text: The service drawer holds a charged battery and instructions for a manual transmission.

options.description: Catch your breath and finish the job

consequence.text: A moment of rest restores your strength.

sections.text: You can still turn back. The safer route is within reach.

options.description: Go back and take the safer route

consequence.text: You are hit again before you can get to safety.

sections.text: The warning goes out. A valley station answers with three clear tones.
